Costs and charges disclosure for Test User
We’ve provided you below with a breakdown of your costs and charges.
Costs and charges breakdown for your Stocks/Shares
Below is your estimated investment costs and charges for your Stocks/Shares. These costs and
charges are based on the amount you’ve told us you’re investing now. You’ll get a statement once a
year of your actual costs and charges.
To help you understand your costs and charges clearly, we’ve shown:
● The total cost and charge of new investments (presented in both monetary and percentage
terms)
● The account fees (costs you pay for the provision of the Vanguard Investor online service)
● The fund management costs (these are the costs taken by the fund manager out of the fund
automatically).

Breakdown of your Account Fees
The total account costs reflect these categories of charges
Charge category £ % of sum invested
Ongoing £1.50 0.15%
Total £1.50 0.15%
Account Fees – these are fees paid to Vanguard:
● Ongoing costs – these are costs we take each year for providing you the online service and
administering your investment accounts. The maximum annual charge is £375.
Cash balances held within your Stocks/Shares may earn interest at a rate determined by Vanguard.
The current rate can be found at https://www.vanguardinvestor.co.uk/need-help/answer/will-i-receive￾interest-on-cash-held-in-my-account.
Vanguard may keep any interest that is received from your cash balances to cover our costs and to
enable us to continue to develop our products and services. This has the effect of increasing the total
cost of your account.
Where payable, interest is earned daily and normally paid into your account on the first business day
of each month. Vanguard does not charge an account fee for any cash which is held in your account.
Please see the Key Features document for further information.

Fund Management Costs – these are fees paid to the fund managers where your investments have
been made:
● One-off costs – these are costs you would pay when entering or exiting your investment. For
ETFs you will incur a Bid-Offer Spread on your trade. We estimate the spread using a rolling 30
day average per fund which may differ from your actual spread
● Ongoing costs – these are costs taken each year by the managers of your investments
● Transaction costs – these are costs incurred by the managers when buying or selling underlying
investments
● Incidental costs – this would be the impact of any performance fee

Cumulative effect of costs and charges on return
Based on these figures, over the period of one year, costs and charges would reduce your investment
from £1,000.00 to £995.59. This is a reduction of £4.41. This assumes a zero growth rate.
If you pay your Account Fee by Direct Debit the value of your investments will be reduced by less than
this amount.
